name: smwgraphics-mario-luigi-bowser-s-inside-story-styled-cave-miscellaneous-blocks
title: Mario & Luigi: Bowser's Inside Story Styled Cave + Miscellaneous Blocks
description:
Here is the custom graphics that I drew for the level "Yoshi Cavern" in my hack. The file contains:

- BIS ? blocks
- BIS used blocks
- BIS message block (Emoglobin block)
- BIS style pipes
- a custom BG

The included sample level shows how the emoglobin block animates, and it contains the palette.

Note: I recommend that you use the redrawn cave FG graphics if you use the pipe graphics, since the ground around the pipe is drawn in that style.
